jsonld_raw.name: (155 G) INCENSE & ORANGE SCENTED CANDLE
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented candle made of vegetable wax.

Incense & Orange | Powerful and profound, intense white flowers lead to the earthy and dry woods that adhere to the fragrance and subtly mystical and mysterious touch.

Notes:
Top notes: tangerine, NEROLI, tea, ylang-ylang.
Heart notes: jasmine, orange blossom, cedar wood, vanilla.
Base notes: incense, patchouli, orange blossom, musk.
